_comment: Canonical model registry. Every production-grade model used by the YorHA legal stack is declared here. rg-searchable — do NOT add to .gitignore. Binary GGUF/ONNX blobs are stored outside git (see pathEnv). Update this file when adding or removing models.

models.description: Gemma 4 E4B with GRPO legal LoRA merged. Serves text + vision (unified model). Primary generation lane.
models.notes: Stored as Ollama blob at %USERPROFILE%\.ollama\blobs\sha256-a79de882... Set TURBO_MODEL_PATH to the blob path or a converted GGUF. 5.3 GB on disk. Requires TURBO_NGL=99 on RTX 3060 Ti.

models.description: Multimodal projector sidecar for Gemma 4. Loaded alongside the primary model for vision input.
models.notes: Place at models/mmproj-BF16.gguf to use the repo-local fallback. If absent, launch-turboquant.ps1 skips --mmproj (text-only mode). BF16 precision. Vision tower frozen during GRPO legal training — compatible with legal fine-tune.

models.description: Primary embedding model. 768-dimensional dense vectors for codebase, evidence, and legal document retrieval.
models.notes: Pulled via Ollama. No GGUF path needed. Served at localhost:11434/api/embed. Canonical lane for Qdrant codebase_chunks_768, evidence_vectors, legal_documents.

models.description: Tiny client-side generation model. Runs in-browser via ONNX Runtime (WebGPU → WASM SIMD → CPU).
models.notes: 418 MB static bundle. Served from /gemma3_270m_onnx/ at runtime. Too large for git — must be copied from models/gemma3_270m/ after cloning. Not in .gitignore so rg can find it.

models.description: Client-side embedding model for browser-local retrieval fallback. 768-dim output.
models.notes: Served from /embeddinggemma_300m_onnx/. Used by client-embed.ts when server embeddings are unavailable. Not gitignored — rg-searchable.

models.description: Canonical merged Gemma 4 legal GGUF in vendor/models/. Used when TURBO_MODEL_PATH points here.
models.notes: gitignored binary blob in vendor/models/. Set TURBO_MODEL_PATH to this absolute path in .env.
gitignored binary in vendor/models/. Set TURBO_MMPROJ_PATH to this path in .env.

models.description: Weight-quantized Gemma 4 E4B via majentik/gemma-4-E4B-RotorQuant-GGUF-IQ4_XS. Runs on stock llama.cpp without TurboQuant binary. Use LEGAL_LORA_PATH to inject legal LoRA at runtime.
models.notes: Optional alternative to merged Ollama blob. Set ROTORQUANT_MODEL_PATH to the GGUF path. Does NOT include legal fine-tune — must add LEGAL_LORA_PATH pointing to the LoRA adapter GGUF.

envVarPolicy.TURBO_MODEL_PATH: Absolute path to primary Gemma 4 GGUF or Ollama blob. Required for llama-server launch.
envVarPolicy.TURBO_MMPROJ_PATH: Absolute path to mmproj-BF16.gguf. Defaults to models/mmproj-BF16.gguf in repo.
envVarPolicy.ROTORQUANT_MODEL_PATH: Optional. Overrides TURBO_MODEL_PATH with a RotorQuant GGUF.
envVarPolicy.TURBO_PROFILE: KV cache profile: stock | turboquant | turboquant-safe | atomicbot (default: stock).
envVarPolicy.TURBO_KV_K: Override KV key cache type (e.g. q8_0, turbo3).
envVarPolicy.TURBO_KV_V: Override KV value cache type (e.g. q8_0, turbo3).
envVarPolicy.TURBO_NGL: GPU offload layers (default: 35; use 99 for full-GPU on RTX 3060 Ti).
envVarPolicy.LLAMA_SERVER_PATH: Path to llama-server.exe. Defaults to bin/llama-server.exe then vendor/llama-server/llama-server.exe.
envVarPolicy.DRAFT_MODEL_PATH: Optional speculative decoding draft model path.
envVarPolicy.LEGAL_LORA_PATH: Optional LoRA adapter GGUF for runtime injection into base-model GGUFs.
